rows.why: No eligible extractable result: AACT supplies no counts or denominators and reports HR rather than the protocol OR; CI sidedness is unspecified. Coverage of the whole randomised population cannot be verified for the dose-restricted FAS. No open full text, regulatory evidence or meta rows supplied.

AACT lists mortality but supplies no counts, denominators or effect estimate; its safety population does not establish the whole randomized population. Composite-outcome HRs are not total mortality ORs. Full text is withheld; no regulatory evidence or meta rows are supplied.

AACT lists all deaths but supplies no counts, denominators or effect estimate. Its safety population is not the required whole randomized population. The mortality-containing composite is a different outcome. No open full text, regulatory evidence or meta rows are supplied.
Apixaban versus enoxaparin/warfarin. Randomized-arm analysis excludes missing endpoints; no site or stratum restriction is stated. Counts supplied for the requested OR estimand; no OR calculated.

AACT reports a composite of recurrent VTE and all-cause mortality, not mortality alone. No standalone mortality counts or effect are supplied. Full text is withheld; no regulatory excerpts or meta rows are provided.

No qualifying result: AACT supplies no mortality counts or denominators; its effect is HR, not OR, and CI sidedness is unspecified. FAS excludes undosed participants, so whole-randomised-population coverage cannot be verified. No open full text, regulatory result or meta row is supplied.
AACT does not report net clinical benefit. No open full text, regulatory windows, or meta rows are supplied. Separate VTE, mortality, and bleeding results cannot establish the requested composite.

AACT reports an HR, not the protocol's OR, for recurrent VTE plus major bleeding. Its 95% CI is not explicitly identified as two-sided for this outcome. No whole-number counts are supplied; full text is withheld and no regulatory or meta result is provided.

Rivaroxaban versus enoxaparin/VKA; two-sided 95% CI. Net clinical benefit comprises recurrent DVT, non-fatal or fatal PE, and major bleeding. Reported estimand is HR, whereas the protocol requests OR. No whole-number counts are provided; no conversion performed.

Candidate composite, not explicitly identified as net clinical benefit. The protocol gives no component definition to confirm equivalence. Counts exclude missing endpoints; no supplied full text establishes the randomized total. No OR reported.

AACT reports recurrent VTE, VTE plus all-cause mortality, and clinically relevant bleeding, but no net clinical benefit result. These outcomes cannot substitute for the requested outcome. Full text is withheld; no regulatory windows or meta rows are supplied.

The supplied AACT results do not report net clinical benefit. Separate VTE, mortality and bleeding outcomes cannot establish this composite. No open full text, regulatory evidence or meta rows are supplied.
